fact: Portail de la Renaissance du Tchad reports Chad's land ministry signed an accord with IGNFI covering modernisation of geographic information systems and digitalisation of cadastral data.
ATPE reports the land ministry signed a partnership with Géo Consult on 5 December 2025 with priorities of modernising the cadastre and developing an urban and land information system.

ATPE reports the Direction générale des Domaines put E-Conservation (SIDCF) into production on 2 October 2023, with the first 5,000 secured land deeds distributed and a database for managing land files.
system: Système informatisé des domaines et de la conservation foncière (SIDCF)

fact: Chad's Cadastre director described parcel regularisation files being checked in the GIRAF database, digitised by the Guichet unique and archived digitally.

Kadaster reported on 3 March 2026 that agents of Chad's land ministry (MATHU) were trained and equipped with GNSS devices and field tablets, and five teams will run a parcel and land-right recordation pilot in N'Djamena's 7th district and rural Linia.
